target: MLB full-game two-way moneyline; unique gamePk, teams, product, period, line, decision, price and settlement
hypothesis: A regularized market-offset logistic model using verified pre-decision player and bullpen information improves out-of-sample log loss over the same-time market and a no-fact baseline.
eligibility: actual receipt of source bytes, full odds vector and decision no later than scheduled start minus 30 minutes
official gamePk and unique team/player identity; announced nine-player orders for both teams
probable starter is labeled probable; final starter only when explicitly confirmed before decision
workload uses only prior completed games received by decision; source and extraction timestamps retained
no target-game stats, play, result or post-decision revisions as features
duplicate source bytes grouped by SHA256 after recomputing from retained bytes; hash is not independent authentication
cancelled, ambiguous, incomplete or late observations are excluded and counted by first reason
features: home-away starter prior strikeout, walk and outs rates based only on prior games
home-away lineup prior batting counts from announced player IDs
home-away bullpen pitches in preceding 24 and 48 hours from prior completed games
venue identity and pre-decision park factor with training-only provenance
missingness is exclusion for required inputs, never zero imputation

design.baseline: market implied probabilities normalized over both sides; no-fact model uses the same offset and training-only intercept
design.candidate: one L2-regularized logistic regression with market logit as fixed offset and standardized home-away fact features; lambda=10, training-only mean and scale, no hand-added probability
design.split: Before reading outcomes of the first eligible new cohort, commit immutable chronological UTC train, validation and final test boundaries and input manifest; same game cannot cross splits; outcomes must actually be received before fitting. No random split, replay of old exposed sample or retuning on test.
design.minimum: At least 300 eligible training games, 100 validation games and 200 subsequent test games, including at least 50 home and 50 away wins per evaluation partition; otherwise blocked_data. This is an operational feasibility threshold, not a power guarantee.
design.selection: Fit baseline and candidate on train; candidate proceeds once only if validation logloss is strictly lower than baseline and market, with full required coverage and no leakage failures; refit on train plus validation available before test, then freeze once. Failure means stop; do not seek a different threshold or split on these outcomes.
design.evaluation: Single locked final test. Report all eligible opportunities, per-arm coverage, common matched subset, accuracy, unit-stake ROI at matched actual quote and settlement, logloss, Brier and chronological maximum drawdown; compare paired game-level losses and weekly block bootstrap intervals. Actual operating frozen picks only where exact revision and selection exist; holds reported separately. No claim of adoption or profitability.
design.stop: Stop on missing eligibility or receipt evidence, fewer than minimum counts, leakage, ambiguous identities or failed validation; do not fit on same evidence again. No automatic model promotion.
